prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1210; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with the trunk lid showing a buckled lower edge. The pattern and location of these marks line up with the rear-end impact described in the report. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing the trunk lid, and reconnecting the wiring harness, with labor hours that fit the extent of the damage. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, and the invoices submitted list each part and task once with no duplicated charges.
